modified_caption: The line plot illustrates Pass@8 accuracy across varying generation temperatures, measured on the merged sets of AIME 2024 and AMC. The 'On-policy RL' line (yellow, triangle markers) shows a steady increase from approximately 63.0 at 0.1 to 75.0 at 0.8, followed by a slight decline to 73.0 at 1.0. The 'LUFFY' line (red, star markers) demonstrates consistent superiority, starting at 76.0 at 0.1 and peaking at 81.0 at 0.8, before stabilizing at 80.0 at 1.0. The 'SFT' line (teal, inverted triangle markers) begins at 73.0 at 0.1, dips sharply to 68.0 at 0.5, and recovers to 74.0 at 1.0, showing the most variability among the three methods. Overall, LUFFY consistently outperforms the other methods across all temperature settings, with On-policy RL showing the most significant improvement over time.

modifications.claim: The 'SFT' line dips sharply to 68.0 at 0.5.
modifications.reality: The 'SFT' line dips to approximately 70.0 at 0.5, not 68.0. The claim exaggerates the depth of the dip.
LUFFY peaks at approximately 81.0 at 1.0, not 80.0. The claim understates the final value.

modifications.claim: On-policy RL shows a steady increase followed by a slight decline at 1.0.
modifications.reality: On-policy RL peaks at 0.8 and does not decline at 1.0; it remains relatively stable after the peak.

correct_elements: Chart type is a line plot.
Pass@8 accuracy is the metric being measured.
Temperature is the x-axis label, ranging from 0.0 to 1.0.
Accuracy (Pass@8) is the y-axis label, ranging from 62.5 to 80.0.
The legend correctly identifies the three methods: On-policy RL, LUFFY, and SFT.
